caption: Issue #539 (loadout phase 4): a regiment can draw the other weapon its soldiers already carry, mid-battle. Infantry deploy holding the gladius with the pilum stowed; Shift+I re-equips the whole regiment and each soldier's silhouette picks up the shaft, then a second press sheathes it and the block reads gladius-and-shield again. Re-equipping is an in-place order -- the block never moves or reforms -- and it is a real trade rather than a free upgrade: the pilum reaches 2.0 m against the gladius's 1.3 m, but lands a blow every 1.5 s against the gladius's 1.2 s and wounds less when it does, so sustained it kills at about half the rate -- holding it too long costs casualties, and switching too early throws the reach away.
